description: Defines an immutable data class for deposit account interest rate charts in the Fineract project, including methods for creating instances, converting from related data, and managing chart slabs.

classes.name: DepositAccountInterestRateChartData
classes.description: Immutable data object representing a deposit account interest rate chart, with methods for instance creation, conversion, and slab management.

methods.description: Creates a new DepositAccountInterestRateChartData instance with specified parameters.
